Title: COMBO PIPER X SOUL OF EARTH

Messages.Author: Felipe Nogueira
Messages.Body:
Good night, once again we from Brazil have a doubt that apparently has not yet been clarified!

Doubt is a Tremere or Tremere antitribu Can Anarchist use Piper + Soul of Earth combo to reduce the cost of an Ally ?

Card: Piper
Master Requires a ready anarch.

Text: A ready unlocked anarch you control employs or recruits a retainer or ally from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is not an action and cannot be blocked. Lock that anarch.

verses

Card: Soul of Earth

Action Card
Requires: Tremere or Tremere antitribu

Text: Put this card on a slave Gargoyle. The Gargoyle with this card can burn it to reduce the cost of recruiting or employing an ally or retainer that requires Gargoyle by up to 3 blood or pool.

I'm waiting thank you.

Piper can be combined with Soul of the Earth to get the cost reduction because Soul of the Earth card text doesn't refers to an action...the employment/recruitment is still done by the anarch minion chosen making Soul of the Earth applicable even though it isn't considered an action being performed by that minion.

Piper

Soul of the Earth
